name: Kaevern
dexEntry: For the majority of its time, Kaevern stays still and gathers a lot of energy for its next evolution. They are wrapped in a thick and very hard exo-skeleton, that protects the actual Kaevern inside. These Pokémon use their tails as a decoy to ward off Flying type Pokémon, which believe the tail to be its head. Its actual head is on the complete opposite side of its body, waiting, lurking for smaller bug type to approach its opening. When they get too close, a terrifying jaw springs out and in a matter of seconds, whatever small Pokémon dared to approach it, becomes its next meal and important nutrients for its final stage.
